fields.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Vayne's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Condemn|Vayne}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Silver Bolts'' for {{fd|3.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications, expiring upon attacking a new enemy, and stacking up to 3 times.
fields.description2: The third stack consumes them all to deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}}, with a minimum threshold.
fields.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus True Damage|{{as|{{ap|6 to 10}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
{{st|Minimum Bonus Damage|{{ap|50 to 110}}}}
fields.notes:
* {{tip|Stacks}} are not removed if '''Vayne''' switches to attacking a target immune to ''Silver Bolts'' ({{tip|structures}}, {{tip|wards}}).
* ''Silver Bolts'' do not apply to additional targets with {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}.
* The stacks can be consumed even if the target is in {{tip|stasis}}.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
